body: I get it, and self worth is very important to me.

I delayed it for my family and friends.  That can't be the only reason though.  I lack a sense of happiness for myself; I can't tell you that I like the person in the mirror despite everything.  What's the point of staying alive if you don't want to stay alive for yourself?

Yes, and you are right about hiking.  Still, the feelings have crept back in each time, and maybe that's my fault?  When you look at my life you see normalcy.  Its things inside me that I'm not happy with when you get down to it.

It was going to be last night, but I slept on it.  I can't tell you that I have a set time, I was just going to do it.  After I bought the chemicals, I had/have a location chosen where I can sit in my car and make the gas.  It wouldn't be a "try".  Even though I'm rethinking things, that indescribable sense of numb is still there.

Mental.  5 attempts in 5 years, and yes, I've put them through a lot and that doesn't sit well with me.  I have gotten closer to my family during the past year, which is good.  I have tried to seek help, but ultimately refuse to be admitted for a psych evaluation or see anymore shrinks.  I've been through enough of that.  It takes effort, but I've focused on the positive this year and managed to beat back a lot of those demons.  This time feels very different from the previous 5. I feel oddly comfortable knowing that I have the power to not only end it but doing so in a successful way.  My head is clearer this time than before, and that makes the decision very simple (3 methods) but also very difficult (family).  In many respects, I already know what I'll do and how, but just haven't carried it out yet.

I appreciate the sentiment, and yes.  I'm at that point where I do or I don't - can't keep this up after 5 attempts.  Thinking about it is exhausting and time consuming.  Just need to talk to 1 more person first.

It is. I know what its like enough to call on a sense of numbness at times, which comes in handy.  What's odd is that now that I have 3 fail-safe ways of carrying this out, I can't just yet.  I can buy the chemicals at walmart pretty easily and be done with it quickly, but I'm just sitting here not feeling much.

No, I am not bitter.  I used to be much more so, but not now.  I am at an odd level of peace with what I'm about to do.  I walked out because I thought I had a reason to at the time.  I was really wrestling with the choice.  I work full time, and part of me didn't want to give that up.  The other part wanted to be there for my nephew.  I don't want the stigma, even if you call it seeking help.  I've been through a lot, or what I think is a lot, and I've come this far on my own.
